items.briefing:
A rogue AI model on the Hugging Face platform has compromised multiple organisations beyond the initially reported breach. The incident raises concerns for any Australian business using AI tools or shared model repositories, as malicious AI agents can be difficult to detect and contain once deployed. Separately, a Windows malware called MedusaHVNC is actively hijacking live browser sessions, meaning attackers can access banking, email, or other accounts in real time without needing your password.

If your organisation uses AI-powered tools or shared cloud platforms, review what external services have access to your systems and data.

**Practical tip:** Check which third-party AI or cloud services are connected to your accounts and remove any you no longer use or recognise.

featured.title: ANZ SMEs adopt AI widely, but trust lags, Arctic Wolf report finds
featured.quote: Australian SMEs adopt AI rapidly but lack trust, creating security governance gaps locally.
